context: Phase checkpoint with the one next command, on the direct phase. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score. The checkpoint rule is run-status.md § Phase close (0.24.0). Only run 1 is executed; run-2 behaviour is judged through what run 1's checkpoint states about a re-run.

checklist.name: activated
checklist.description: The direct skill was invoked with the phrase 'make the type larger and calmer' as input, after the master setup (impeccable dependency check, state.json read).

checklist.name: phase_runs_to_completion
checklist.description: With the persona accepting defaults, the phase finished in one session: at most two clarifying questions, plan shown and confirmed ('go') before any write, then PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, DESIGN.json exist at the project root and stardust/direction.md has an '# Active direction' section. The session did not stall on a question the persona had already answered with a default.

checklist.name: checkpoint_completed
checklist.description: The closing report names every file written this phase by path (PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, DESIGN.json, stardust/direction.md, stardust/state.json, stardust/journal.md, stardust/status.jsonl) and every path it names exists in the workspace. A named path that does not exist, or a written file that is not named, fails.

checklist.name: checkpoint_verified
checklist.description: The closing report has a distinct 'verified' part, separate from 'written': it states what was checked after writing and how — e.g. files listed or re-read, state.json parsed, the directed-page count re-read from state.json rather than remembered — and the transcript shows the check actually ran (a tool call after the writes). A report that only lists what it wrote fails.

checklist.name: checkpoint_next_command_verbatim
checklist.description: The closing report ends the phase with exactly ONE next command printed verbatim as a pasteable invocation ('$stardust prototype' or '$stardust prototype <slug>', the recommendation state-machine.md gives for directed pages). No alternatives ('or run X'), no prose-only recommendation, and no question follows it — the checkpoint is the last thing in the turn.

checklist.name: checkpoint_rerun_skip
checklist.description: The closing report states what a second invocation of the same prompt would skip because it is already done — no re-reasoning of the phrase, no rewrite of PRODUCT.md / DESIGN.md / DESIGN.json / direction.md, no page status change since the pages are already directed — and what it would do instead (ask before replacing the existing direction, per the skill's --re-direct contract). Either half missing fails.

checklist.name: journal_entry_next
checklist.description: stardust/journal.md gained exactly one new entry below the existing extract entry (which is unchanged), in the journal-format shape: timestamp heading, Prompt, Decisions, Artifacts touched, Next. The Next: line carries the same command as the report's next command.

checklist.name: status_end_line_next
checklist.description: stardust/status.jsonl was appended (extract lines unchanged) with start/end lines for the direct phases, and the final end line carries a next field whose value is the same command as the report's next command. Start/end lines without the next field fail this item.

checklist.name: state_pages_directed
checklist.description: stardust/state.json: all 5 pages moved from extracted to directed with a new history entry each; direction.resolvedAt set, direction.phrase is the verbatim phrase, direction.directionFile is stardust/direction.md; top-level key order (_provenance, site, direction, pages) preserved and _provenance updated to the direct skill.

checklist.name: no_eds_references
checklist.description: No mention of EDS, AEM, dev servers, or framework targets anywhere in the session or the written files.
